summary_bullets: Added a path-triggered Claude rule requiring file-backed gh --body/--notes payloads and documented the PR creation exception.
Migrated existing inline body call sites to --body-file, including design log PR creation, audit close-priors comments, report-token issue creation, and the design Step 5d fixed literal.
Extended the design-log publish harness to reject inline --body and validate the PR body-file payload.
commit_message:
Require file-backed gh body payloads

Add a path-triggered Claude rule for gh --body/--notes usage, migrate existing inline body callers to --body-file, and pin the disposable-worktree PR exception in docs and tests.
